dictation.title: Catch every word
dictation.desc: Focus on one sentence. Replay it as often as you need.
dictation.listen_hint: Listen first, then type what you hear.
dictation.fb_perfect: Every word matched. Try the next sentence.
dictation.fb_high: Most words matched. Listen again for the remaining details.
dictation.fb_medium: Try a hint or a slower listening speed.
dictation.fb_low: Listen again for linking sounds, articles and word endings.
dictation.copy_failed: Unable to copy. Check clipboard permission.

practice.title: Make the sentence your own
practice.headphones_note: Record at 1x with a silent video cue. Use headphones for the sample. Recordings stay in this session.
practice.timing_changed: Timing changed. Record this sentence again before replaying the lesson.
practice.words_changed: The words changed. Listen to check your recording.
practice.unrecorded_note: Unrecorded sentences use the original audio. {{partLeft}} left in this part · {{videoLeft}} in the video.

editor.title: Edit transcript before practice
editor.desc: BE transcript is a draft. Listen and verify words and cues for each sentence.
editor.guideline: Mark beginning of each part based on content. No need to distribute time evenly. Cue points are suggestions; verify with audio.
editor.split_title: Split sentence in two; adjust timing afterwards
editor.new_part_checkbox: Start new part at this sentence
editor.remove_takes_warning: Applying will discard {{count}} recordings from deleted or merged sentences. I understand.
editor.notes: Sentences with timing changes need rerecording. Text edits require review. Unchanged sentences keep their takes.

screen.transcript_prepare_error: This transcript could not be prepared. Try reloading it or choose another video.
screen.lesson_safe_note: Your current lesson and recordings are still available.
screen.hero_eyebrow: Listen. Understand. Make it your own.
screen.hero_title: Practice with a video you enjoy
screen.hero_desc: Listen closely with Dictation, or practice your voice with Shadowing. Start with a YouTube video and work through it one sentence at a time.
screen.dictation_desc: Train your ear. Listen, write and check each sentence.
screen.shadowing_desc: Find your rhythm. Record, replay and compare your voice.
screen.hero_session_note: You can review the transcript before you start. Recordings are kept for this session.
screen.step_01_desc: Follow the original voice, one sentence at a time.
screen.step_02_shadowing_desc: Record with the video as your silent cue.
screen.step_02_dictation_desc: Notice the small words and connected sounds.
screen.step_03_shadowing_desc: Listen back to a part or the full video.
screen.step_03_dictation_desc: Use feedback to catch what you missed.
screen.practice_help_p1: Listen to a sentence, then type what you hear or record your voice. You can review each part and the whole video.
screen.practice_help_p2: Recordings are kept for this session. Reloading or leaving this page will clear them.
screen.ready_card_title: A few moments to get familiar
screen.ready_card_desc: Preview the video, then start practicing. You can edit the words, sentence timing and parts whenever you need.
screen.review_timing_notice: Some transcript timings or sentences need a review. Open the editor before starting.
screen.review_takes_notice: This transcript replaces sentences with recordings. Review the changes in the editor before applying them.
screen.open_video_dialog_desc: Your current lesson stays available until you apply a new transcript. Starting a different video clears the current recordings.
